BiblicalUsage: Ben-Abinadab means "son of Abinadab." He was an officer of Solomon. You will find it in 1 Kings 4:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God kept Ben-Abinadab in the record on purpose, and that is reason enough to know it.
